title: Lambda functions in a region
description: Enumerates Lambda function names in one region via the list-only resource.

outputs.name: region
outputs.description: Region the function is deployed in

cost.notes: One list call per region when swept account-wide

template: SELECT function_name, region FROM aws.lambda.functions_list_only WHERE region = '{{region}}';
notes: Lambda is regional: fan out over the enabled regions from aws/ec2/regions-enabled for an account-wide inventory. For configuration detail, read aws.lambda.functions with data__Identifier set to the function name, one request per function.
